name: SurrealDB Agent Memory
summary: Managed memory and knowledge layer for agents on SurrealDB: facts with provenance and supersession, hybrid retrieval, and a built-in MCP server.
description: Conversations, documents and structured data become entities, attributes, relationships, instructions and sources stored together, with a tri-temporal model (system, known, valid time) in which corrections supersede old facts while the old fact is kept. Each Context serves REST and MCP (Streamable HTTP) at https://<context-host>/mcp with a static Bearer API key bound to that Context (no OAuth); tools: remember, recall, context, reflect, forget, upload, inspect. Python and TypeScript SDKs plus adapters for LangChain, OpenAI Agents, Vercel AI SDK and CrewAI. Plans: Sandbox free (3M tokens, one-off), Lite $30/month (1M tokens), Standard $300 (10M), Plus $1,100 (40M), Enterprise custom. SurrealDB reports a 77.2% BEAM 1M score.

agent_access.notes: Per-Context MCP endpoint https://<context-host>/mcp with Authorization: Bearer <context API key>.
